Setup.title: Setup

unified.setupDescription: Configure components, attributes, options, and pricing in one place. Expand sections to edit.

guide.howItWorksDescription: Get your product configurator up and running in four steps.
guide.step1Description: Import from SketchUp (.skp + .glb) for automatic setup, or create a product model manually.
guide.step2Description: Define what customers can choose: colors, sizes, materials. Set up components and their attributes.
guide.step3Description: Define how each option affects the price — fixed amounts or per-unit increments.
guide.step4Description: Set the embed URL, publish, and copy the iframe code to place the configurator on your website.
guide.importDescription: Upload .skp and .glb files to auto-create a product with components and attributes.
guide.requestsDescription: View quote inquiries submitted through your embedded configurator.
guide.tipBody: Export your SketchUp model as .glb (File > Export > glTF). Use Dynamic Components for configurable parameters (colors, dimensions). The app extracts parameters automatically from the .skp file during import.

SketchUpImport.title: Import from SketchUp
SketchUpImport.description: Upload the configurator zip from the SketchUp plugin (Plugins → Configurator → Export). The zip contains the 3D model, parameters, and materials. After import, set prices and preview in the configurator.

form.productNameHint: Leave empty to use the zip filename as the product name.
form.configuratorZipHint: Zip from SketchUp plugin: model.glb + parameters.json + materials/. Export via Plugins → Configurator → Export for Configurator (single zip).
